title: Full faithfulness of a K-injective derived functor
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with K-injective resolutions in $\mathcal A$. Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive, fully faithful and preserve K-injective complexes. Then its total right derived functor $RF:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ is full and faithful.

proof.text: For K-injective complexes I,J, compute RF(QI) and RF(QJ) by applying F termwise. The derived unit is invertible on these complexes.

The maps into QJ and Q(FJ) are the homotopy classes of complex maps. Since F is fully faithful, it is bijective on complex maps and on homotopies, hence on their homotopy classes. The comparison is exactly RF on morphisms by naturality of the derived unit.
Represent any two derived objects by K-injectives, conjugate the preceding bijection by their representing isomorphisms, and take its surjective and injective halves.
